briefing: Markets stayed risk-off today with the NASDAQ down 1.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.6%. No candidates were screened and cash on hand ($289.29) is below the deployment threshold, so we're holding all 7 existing positions rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly pull back from riskier assets like growth stocks, causing indices like the NASDAQ to fall more than safer benchmarks. The right response isn't to panic-sell or chase new trades — it's to hold quality positions and wait for clearer signals before deploying more capital.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off)是指投資者普遍減少持有成長股等高風險資產,導致納斯達克等指數跌幅大於較穩健的指數。正確的應對方式並非恐慌性拋售或追逐新交易,而是持有優質倉位,待訊號更明確時才部署更多資金。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices fell today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500, a pattern typical of risk-off sessions where investors rotate out of higher-beta growth names. No specific confirmed headlines are available for today, so the move reflects general market caution rather than a single catalyst. Days like this call for patience over reactive trading.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍下跌,以科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅(-1.3%)超過標普500指數(-0.6%),屬於典型的「風險規避」市況,反映資金從高波動的成長股撤出。由於今日未有確認的具體新聞標題可供引用,此次下跌更多反映市場整體審慎情緒,而非單一觸發因素。此類日子宜保持耐性,避免倉促交易。
